title: Protect the task-board checks with trusted review policy
body:
Simulation case: feature
Rules added, changed, and removed (give IDs or write none): Preserve the task-board rules. Install the trusted review policy for the SIMULATED FEATURE REQUEST and SIMULATED PRODUCT RULES.
Old behavior: The bootstrap gate protected two smoke tests and accepted an exact-head dispatch input.
New behavior: The protected base defines five required tests, the known patch digest, reportable code review cases, and proof of exact-head CI and simulated verdicts. No task-board behavior changes.
